definitions.short: properly, extension , i.e. height or breadth ; also a measure (including its standard); hence a portion (as measured) or a vestment ; specifically, tribute (as measured)
definitions.usage: garment, measure(-ing, meteyard, piece, size, (great) stature, tribute, wide.
